svg.title: Motor spindle section - parts numbered in assembly order
svg.text: Motor spindle (example of the twin) – section with all assembly parts numbered in ASSEMBLY ORDER
12 000 rpm, HSK-A63, front 4 × 7014 C hybrid TBT (fixed), rear 2 × 7012 C DB (floating), sizes from web/spindle.js – schematic, seals simplified
x in mm from the nose face (nose left, tail right)
Shaft – nose down in stand J1
6, 7 Front bearings 3 + 4 (pair B, O to A)
Accent lines in the bearings = contact lines (15°).
Blue small boxes = sensors (PT100, clamp sensor).
Assembly rule of the step-down shaft:
every part slides on from the REAR: Ø120 nose > Ø70 front seat > M70 > Ø68 > Ø65 rotor seat > Ø63 > Ø60 rear seat > M60 > Ø50 tail.
Steps 6–11: shaft nose down in J1 (parts 2–14). Steps 13–18: housing nose up on J8 (parts 15–21).
Scale ≈ 1 : 0.7 (1.45 px per mm). Values: twin example.
